<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq" aria-labelledby="faq-title">
	<h2 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq__title" id="faq-title">Frequently asked questions about deep linking</h2>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq__content">
		

<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-bbvshq1kz2a"
			id="faq-question-bbvshq1kz2a">
			Can I use deep linking without AppsFlyer's attribution platform?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-bbvshq1kz2a" hidden>
		Yes. Deep Linking Suite is available as a standalone product, independent of paid media attribution. It's designed for CRM, lifecycle, and growth teams driving users from owned channels like email, SMS, web, QR, or social directly to specific in-app experiences. You get full deep linking capabilities without needing the complete measurement platform.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-pwa036zj7si"
			id="faq-question-pwa036zj7si">
			Does deep linking work for owned media campaigns?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-pwa036zj7si" hidden>
		Yes. Deep linking works across every channel, paid or owned. Whether running paid social and UA campaigns or engaging existing users through email, SMS, web, or QR, you control where each link sends users. Get consistent routing across platforms and devices, plus performance signals to optimize every campaign.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-kg1p336lff"
			id="faq-question-kg1p336lff">
			Do you offer deferred deep linking?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-kg1p336lff" hidden>
		Yes. Our solution is built on proprietary OneLink technology that understands where to direct a user regardless of whether an app is installed or not. If the app is not installed, deferred deep linking occurs: users are directed to the right app store to download your app, after which they are routed to the desired in-app content.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-msj3nqegjx"
			id="faq-question-msj3nqegjx">
			How can I set up deep links for my app?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-msj3nqegjx" hidden>
		Setting up deep links involves different methods depending on the operating system. It's typically done through Universal Links on iOS, or App Links on Android. Another method is using a custom URI scheme, but this is less secure and popular.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-cabzso5dahv"
			id="faq-question-cabzso5dahv">
			Do I need deep linking if I use iOS Universal Links or Android App Links?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-cabzso5dahv" hidden>
		Yes. Otherwise you'll still have to create links for each platform. Our solution uses both Apple and Android's deep linking mechanisms (iOS Universal Links and Android App Links, respectively), allowing you to create a single link that automatically determines the best way to route your users regardless of channel, platform, or OS.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-f2lpnu5jegw"
			id="faq-question-f2lpnu5jegw">
			What attribution data can I get from your deep links?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-f2lpnu5jegw" hidden>
		Our deep links contain rich attribution data about user journeys including what campaign they came from, who referred them, what content they saw when clicking on the link, and more. This contextual information helps you optimize your campaigns and the user experience from the click to when the app is opened.	</div>
</div>

		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">

			id="faq-question-bbvshq1kz2a">
			Can I use deep linking without AppsFlyer's attribution platform?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-bbvshq1kz2a" hidden>
		Yes. Deep Linking Suite is available as a standalone product, independent of paid media attribution. It's designed for CRM, lifecycle, and growth teams driving users from owned channels like email, SMS, web, QR, or social directly to specific in-app experiences. You get full deep linking capabilities without needing the complete measurement platform.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-pwa036zj7si"
			id="faq-question-pwa036zj7si">
			Does deep linking work for owned media campaigns?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-pwa036zj7si" hidden>
		Yes. Deep linking works across every channel, paid or owned. Whether running paid social and UA campaigns or engaging existing users through email, SMS, web, or QR, you control where each link sends users. Get consistent routing across platforms and devices, plus performance signals to optimize every campaign.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-kg1p336lff"
			id="faq-question-kg1p336lff">
			Do you offer deferred deep linking?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-kg1p336lff" hidden>
		Yes. Our solution is built on proprietary OneLink technology that understands where to direct a user regardless of whether an app is installed or not. If the app is not installed, deferred deep linking occurs: users are directed to the right app store to download your app, after which they are routed to the desired in-app content.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-msj3nqegjx"
			id="faq-question-msj3nqegjx">
			How can I set up deep links for my app?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-msj3nqegjx" hidden>
		Setting up deep links involves different methods depending on the operating system. It's typically done through Universal Links on iOS, or App Links on Android. Another method is using a custom URI scheme, but this is less secure and popular.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-cabzso5dahv"
			id="faq-question-cabzso5dahv">
			Do I need deep linking if I use iOS Universal Links or Android App Links?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-cabzso5dahv" hidden>
		Yes. Otherwise you'll still have to create links for each platform. Our solution uses both Apple and Android's deep linking mechanisms (iOS Universal Links and Android App Links, respectively), allowing you to create a single link that automatically determines the best way to route your users regardless of channel, platform, or OS.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-f2lpnu5jegw"
			id="faq-question-f2lpnu5jegw">
			What attribution data can I get from your deep links?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-f2lpnu5jegw" hidden>
		Our deep links contain rich attribution data about user journeys including what campaign they came from, who referred them, what content they saw when clicking on the link, and more. This contextual information helps you optimize your campaigns and the user experience from the click to when the app is opened.	</div>
</div>

<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">

		</span>

	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-bbvshq1kz2a" hidden>

</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">

			aria-controls="faq-answer-pwa036zj7si"
			id="faq-question-pwa036zj7si">
			Does deep linking work for owned media campaigns?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-pwa036zj7si" hidden>
		Yes. Deep linking works across every channel, paid or owned. Whether running paid social and UA campaigns or engaging existing users through email, SMS, web, or QR, you control where each link sends users. Get consistent routing across platforms and devices, plus performance signals to optimize every campaign.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-kg1p336lff"
			id="faq-question-kg1p336lff">
			Do you offer deferred deep linking?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-kg1p336lff" hidden>
		Yes. Our solution is built on proprietary OneLink technology that understands where to direct a user regardless of whether an app is installed or not. If the app is not installed, deferred deep linking occurs: users are directed to the right app store to download your app, after which they are routed to the desired in-app content.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">

		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-msj3nqegjx" hidden>

</div>

<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq" aria-labelledby="faq-title">
	<h2 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq__title" id="faq-title">Frequently asked questions about deep linking</h2>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq__content">
		

<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-bbvshq1kz2a"
			id="faq-question-bbvshq1kz2a">
			Can I use deep linking without AppsFlyer's attribution platform?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-bbvshq1kz2a" hidden>
		Yes. Deep Linking Suite is available as a standalone product, independent of paid media attribution. It's designed for CRM, lifecycle, and growth teams driving users from owned channels like email, SMS, web, QR, or social directly to specific in-app experiences. You get full deep linking capabilities without needing the complete measurement platform.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-pwa036zj7si"
			id="faq-question-pwa036zj7si">
			Does deep linking work for owned media campaigns?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-pwa036zj7si" hidden>
		Yes. Deep linking works across every channel, paid or owned. Whether running paid social and UA campaigns or engaging existing users through email, SMS, web, or QR, you control where each link sends users. Get consistent routing across platforms and devices, plus performance signals to optimize every campaign.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-kg1p336lff"
			id="faq-question-kg1p336lff">
			Do you offer deferred deep linking?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-kg1p336lff" hidden>
		Yes. Our solution is built on proprietary OneLink technology that understands where to direct a user regardless of whether an app is installed or not. If the app is not installed, deferred deep linking occurs: users are directed to the right app store to download your app, after which they are routed to the desired in-app content.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-msj3nqegjx"
			id="faq-question-msj3nqegjx">
			How can I set up deep links for my app?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-msj3nqegjx" hidden>
		Setting up deep links involves different methods depending on the operating system. It's typically done through Universal Links on iOS, or App Links on Android. Another method is using a custom URI scheme, but this is less secure and popular.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-cabzso5dahv"
			id="faq-question-cabzso5dahv">
			Do I need deep linking if I use iOS Universal Links or Android App Links?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-cabzso5dahv" hidden>
		Yes. Otherwise you'll still have to create links for each platform. Our solution uses both Apple and Android's deep linking mechanisms (iOS Universal Links and Android App Links, respectively), allowing you to create a single link that automatically determines the best way to route your users regardless of channel, platform, or OS.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-f2lpnu5jegw"
			id="faq-question-f2lpnu5jegw">

		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-f2lpnu5jegw" hidden>

<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq" aria-labelledby="faq-title">
	<h2 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq__title" id="faq-title">Frequently asked questions about deep linking</h2>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq__content">
		

<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-bbvshq1kz2a"
			id="faq-question-bbvshq1kz2a">
			Can I use deep linking without AppsFlyer's attribution platform?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-bbvshq1kz2a" hidden>
		Yes. Deep Linking Suite is available as a standalone product, independent of paid media attribution. It's designed for CRM, lifecycle, and growth teams driving users from owned channels like email, SMS, web, QR, or social directly to specific in-app experiences. You get full deep linking capabilities without needing the complete measurement platform.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-pwa036zj7si"
			id="faq-question-pwa036zj7si">
			Does deep linking work for owned media campaigns?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-pwa036zj7si" hidden>
		Yes. Deep linking works across every channel, paid or owned. Whether running paid social and UA campaigns or engaging existing users through email, SMS, web, or QR, you control where each link sends users. Get consistent routing across platforms and devices, plus performance signals to optimize every campaign.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-kg1p336lff"
			id="faq-question-kg1p336lff">
			Do you offer deferred deep linking?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-kg1p336lff" hidden>
		Yes. Our solution is built on proprietary OneLink technology that understands where to direct a user regardless of whether an app is installed or not. If the app is not installed, deferred deep linking occurs: users are directed to the right app store to download your app, after which they are routed to the desired in-app content.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-msj3nqegjx"
			id="faq-question-msj3nqegjx">
			How can I set up deep links for my app?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-msj3nqegjx" hidden>
		Setting up deep links involves different methods depending on the operating system. It's typically done through Universal Links on iOS, or App Links on Android. Another method is using a custom URI scheme, but this is less secure and popular.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-cabzso5dahv"
			id="faq-question-cabzso5dahv">
			Do I need deep linking if I use iOS Universal Links or Android App Links?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-cabzso5dahv" hidden>
		Yes. Otherwise you'll still have to create links for each platform. Our solution uses both Apple and Android's deep linking mechanisms (iOS Universal Links and Android App Links, respectively), allowing you to create a single link that automatically determines the best way to route your users regardless of channel, platform, or OS.	</div>
</div>



<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-f2lpnu5jegw"
			id="faq-question-f2lpnu5jegw">
			What attribution data can I get from your deep links?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-f2lpnu5jegw" hidden>
		Our deep links contain rich attribution data about user journeys including what campaign they came from, who referred them, what content they saw when clicking on the link, and more. This contextual information helps you optimize your campaigns and the user experience from the click to when the app is opened.	</div>
</div>
